chidram, dvāram, vivaram, suṣiram, kuharam छिद्रम्, द्वारम्, विवरम्, सुशिरम्, कुहरम्
Orifice

ITA-5.43.8 chidrodaraḥ/ kṣatodaraḥ छिद्रोदरः/क्षतोदरः
Acute abdominal swelling caused by intestinal perforation
An acute and life threatening illness characterized by increased abdominal distension below the umbilicus; passing of blackish stools; passing of bluish stools; passing of yellowish stools; passing of slimy stools; passing of stools smelling of dead body; passing of unformed stools with ama; hiccups; breathlessness/difficulty in breathing; cough; thirst; excessive urination; loss of taste; indigestion; weakness; watery discharge from anus; severe needling type of pain; indigestion; frequent scanty stool-coloured discharge from anus; giddiness or dizziness; tearing.
